title: draba olympica var. heterocoma
intro: Draba olympica var. heterocoma, commonly known as Olympic draba, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Olympic draba are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
